notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill applies Istio patterns to AI inference traffic: strict mTLS, per-service-account AuthorizationPolicies, egress allow-listing for model APIs, header/weight-based canary routing, circuit breaking, retry budgets, locality failover, telemetry and Kiali/istioctl diagnostics.

Medium: SKILL.md:25-37 has the agent install Istio into the user's cluster with istioctl, create and label a namespace; SKILL.md:401-413 port-forwards Kiali in the background and queries its local API with curl. The YAML manifests, once applied, reconfigure cluster traffic and security policy. Acceptable because these are standard setup and read-only diagnostic steps for the user's own cluster and the policies tighten security (STRICT mTLS, deny-by-namespace, egress allow-list).

Review before applying: the cluster-wide PeerAuthentication in istio-system (SKILL.md:44-52) enforces STRICT mTLS for every namespace and can break non-mesh workloads; the egress allow-list host 'models.anthropic.com' (SKILL.md:158) is not Anthropic's API host (api.anthropic.com) and should be corrected. Related Skills (SKILL.md:427-429) link to sibling skills ../service-mesh/, ../llm-gateway/, ../../../devops/observability/opentelemetry/ as optional reading only.
